name: Quantum Etz Chaim Tabletop Demonstrator

scientificBoundary.implemented: A deterministic classical QEC runtime with physical controls, indicators, trace display, and a versioned host-to-panel protocol.
scientificBoundary.notClaimed: The apparatus is not a quantum processor and does not produce qubit superposition, entanglement, quantum error correction, or quantum speedup.
scientificBoundary.laboratoryExtension: A future laboratory adapter may exchange versioned jobs and traces with an independently validated quantum-control backend without reclassifying QEC-1 itself as quantum hardware.

compute.hostPower: Official or equivalently certified 5 V / 5 A USB-C supply
compute.storage: 32 GB or larger high-endurance microSD; NVMe optional

verification: No continuity between either DC rail and chassis
PANEL_5V polarity verified before controller connection
All 56 indicators pass low-brightness walking test
Every key produces exactly one debounced event
Host and panel reject incompatible protocol versions
Disconnecting USB or panel power produces a visible fault without state mutation
Identical source and seed reproduce the same trace hash and checksum

tiers.name: Tabletop demonstrator
tiers.description: Classical host, physical panel, deterministic QEC runtime, LEDs, keys, and trace display.

tiers.name: Hardware-in-the-loop controller
tiers.description: Adds an isolated FPGA or RFSoC loopback target for timing and protocol experiments; it still does not control qubits.

tiers.name: Quantum backend adapter
tiers.description: Connects through a reviewed backend contract to independently operated quantum-control equipment and required RF, cryogenic, calibration, and safety systems.
